card.name: Digits inside long ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long identifier, such as a hex profile ID, ISSN, ZIP+4, DOI, report number, page range or clock time. It fires on the digit that follows a partial number.

modes.label: Hex and ID strings
modes.description: A digit inside a long hexadecimal or alphanumeric code in a URL.

modes.label: Reference numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an ISSN, ZIP+4, report number, DOI or page range.

modes.label: Clock times
modes.description: The first digit of the hour in a timestamp after a date.

card.writes: It promotes assorted short fragments and suppresses hex-like strings, so there is no clear output effect on the next digit.
card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle of a long code or reference number, like an ISSN, ZIP+4 or web ID.
